<a id="sprite_buf_a_spr0"></a>
### [`sprite_buf_a_spr0`](../../../src/actor_sprite_buffers.asm#L10) `$8180-$81BF`

*variable*

Sprite blocks $06-$0F (64 bytes each), written at run time; the image bytes do not matter. The sprite builder copy_sprite_frame draws the actors here, buffer A (blocks $06-$0A) and buffer B (blocks $0B-$0F) in turn (sprite_buffer_select selects; sprite_buffer_addresses holds the block addresses, sprite_buffer_pointers the block numbers for sprite_pointers+0..4). Sprite block $06: image of hardware sprite 0 (actor 0 = Bruce, first sprite), buffer A.

- **Written by:** [`reset_play_state`](play_init.md#reset_play_state) [`$07C2`](../../../src/play_init.asm#L65), [`reset_play_state`](play_init.md#reset_play_state) [`$07C2`](../../../src/play_init.asm#L65) (+1)
- **Entry of:** [`sprite_buffer_addresses`](../tables.md#sprite_buffer_addresses)
